qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers fuel delivery and metering system torque specifications?
What is the difference in torque values between the fuel injector mounting and its coupling nut?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel injector to intake manifold uses 10 Nm, while the coupling nut requires 25 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Does the fuel injector to intake manifold torque specification apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it applies to all vehicle types.
